MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Common Rules: Shapes is an array object. The Tag field sets the voxel value for each             region; if Tag is missing, use 0. Tag must be smaller than the maximum media number in the  	   input file.Most parameters are in floating-point (FP). If a parameter is a coordinate, it  	   assumes the origin is defined at the lowest corner of the first voxel, unless user overwrite 	   with an Origin object. The default origin of all shapes is initialized by user's --srcfrom0  	   setting: if srcfrom0=1, the lowest corner of the 1st voxel is [0,0,0]; otherwise, it is [1,1,1]
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Name: Just for documentation purposes, not parsed in MCX
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Origin: A floating-point (FP) triplet, set coordinate origin for the subsequent objects
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Grid: Recreate the background grid with the given dimension (Size) and fill-value (Tag)
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Sphere: A 3D sphere, centered at C0 with radius R, both have FP values
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Box: A 3D box, with lower corner O and edge length Size, both have FP values
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::SubGrid: A sub-section of the grid, integer O- and Size-triplet, inclusive of both ends
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::XLayers/YLayers/ZLayers: Layered structures, defined by an array of integer triples:              [start,end,tag]. Ends are inclusive in MATLAB array indices. XLayers are perpendicular to x-axis, and so on
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::XSlabs/YSlabs/ZSlabs: Slab structures, consisted of a list of FP pairs [start,end]             both ends are inclusive in MATLAB array indices, all XSlabs are perpendicular to x-axis, and so on
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::Cylinder: A finite cylinder, defined by the two ends, C0 and C1, along the axis and a radius R
MCX_Shape_Command_Help.Shapes::UpperSpace: A semi-space defined by inequality A*x+B*y+C*z>D, Coef is required, but not Equ
